qa.overall_assessment: Cycle 2 fix correctly switches SidebarBashView from horizontal-scroll to soft-wrap. Long bash command (~225 chars) now wraps to ~3 lines within the popup at both desktop (450px wide) and mobile (390px wide). break-all wordBreak applied (web-only via Platform.OS guard). flexShrink:1 and flexWrap:'wrap' applied via opt-in wrap prop.
